title: Property-specific qualification tolerances and mandatory gates
timing: Threshold candidates were documented before formal generation; explicit approval and freeze occurred after formal extraction and descriptive policy-enforcement analysis, but before qualification labeling, validity-domain construction, mixed-model qualification inference, or confirmation-outcome access.
evidence_classification: Literature-informed and resolution-aware study-specific engineering tolerances; not universal IEEE or IEC acceptance limits.

flicker.modulation_frequency_hz.rule: max(one record-length modulation-frequency bin, 2% of absolute truth)
flicker.modulation_frequency_hz.rationale: The modulation peak is obtained from the record-length envelope FFT, not the 0-3 kHz transform frequency grid.

standardized_rmse.nonestimable_rule: A nonestimable primary result fails the record-level tolerance indicator and may not be assigned a finite error.

all_record_tolerance_pass_proportion.definition: proportion of all expected records with a finite estimate and absolute error <= epsilon_record

calibration.alternative: A frozen development calibration may satisfy this gate only if equivalent performance is retained unchanged in confirmation.

requirements: target response is monotonic and physically plausible
target effect exceeds the largest nuisance effect

decision_semantics.development_gate_pass: All mandatory development gates pass over the declared development domain.
decision_semantics.development_gate_fail: At least one mandatory development gate fails.
decision_semantics.conditionally_qualified: Permitted only for a physically interpretable development-derived validity domain frozen before confirmation and tested unchanged in confirmation.
decision_semantics.final_qualified: Prohibited until unchanged confirmation retains the development decision and its uncertainty requirement.
decision_semantics.not_qualified: Assigned after criterion-level evidence establishes failure over the claimed domain; no method may be rescued by post-hoc retuning.

multiplicity.primary: Holm family-wise error rate 0.05 within each physical-property family
multiplicity.exploratory: Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate 0.05 with explicit exploratory label

prohibited: selecting or changing thresholds to optimize observed method rankings or pass rates
silently excluding structurally undefined primary estimates
changing the 125 Hz high-band boundary for primary analysis
accessing confirmation outcomes before all remaining calibration and validity-domain artifacts are frozen and externally registered

required_reporting.tolerance_sensitivity: Report results at 0.5x, 1x, and 2x epsilon without changing the primary 1x decision.
required_reporting.timing_disclosure: Disclose the exact post-extraction, pre-qualification approval timing.
required_reporting.standards_boundary: Do not represent these study-specific tolerances as IEEE or IEC compliance limits.

confirmation_firewall: No confirmation outcomes generated or inspected at threshold freeze; confirmation analysis remains blocked pending external registration and all remaining freeze artifacts.
hash_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with policy_sha256 set to null
